newsitem.title: UK: Innovative Tech to buy PolyMedica units.
newsitem.headline: Innovative Tech to buy PolyMedica units.

text.p: British specialist materials group Innovative Technlogies Group Plc said on Monday it planned to acquire the U.S. and UK wound care divisions of PolyMedica Industries Inc.
Innovative Technologies will pay $8.0 million in cash and an unsecured promissory note in the face amount of $5 million.

The UK company will also pay an additional consideration up to $7 million in the form of ordinary shares in the company depending on Innovative Technologies achieving future fixed milestones within 10 years of the date of completion.

Innovative will pay half of the consideration if its mid-market share price reaches 6.67 stg and the rest will be paid if the revenues of the PolyMedica divisions being acquired reach $6.0 million per annum after the said share price was achieved.
Innovative's share price closed 4-1/2 pence up at 307 pence on Monday.
Polymedica's wound care divisions apply microporous technology to wound care and specialise in membrane wound dressings.

Commenting on the acquisition, Keith Gilding, Innovative Tech's chief executive said: "it fills the one fundamental gap in our product portfolio and we are now able to supply our customers with a full range of wound care products".
